movie_title: The criminal trade in ancient objects ⏲️ 6 Minute English
introduction: Many of us like to visit museums to see ancient artefacts in person – it's an exciting way to learn

vocabulary.definition: any object made by humans, usually very old, which is historically interesting
vocabulary.example: The museum had a collection of ancient artefacts from Egypt and Greece.
The looted treasures were returned to their rightful owners.

vocabulary.definition: a new element that completely changes a situation when introduced
vocabulary.example: The invention of the internet was a game changer in how we access information.

vocabulary.definition: a problem that delays a process or stops it from progressing
vocabulary.example: The lack of resources created a bottleneck in the project timeline.

vocabulary.definition: to return something to the country it came from
vocabulary.example: The government agreed to repatriate the stolen artifacts to their original country.

vocabulary.definition: describing things which are not extreme and are acceptable to most people
vocabulary.example: Her political views are middle-of-the-road, appealing to a broad range of voters.
